name: tell-tail
description: Local desktop activity, MCP diagnostics and tool-call observability for ChatGPT and Codex on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Desktop activity for ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Explore supported desktop events, connections, MCP diagnostics and plugin tool results in one local Activity timeline. Persistent tool capture requires setup and a one-time Codex restart. Metadata only; bounded in-memory history. Complete cloud activity is not observed.
defaultPrompt: Set up Tell-Tail for ChatGPT and Codex.
Check Tell-Tail capture health and open Activity.
